title: Fonts In Use – Find out where a font is used
summary: Fonts In Use is a curated archive showcasing real-world examples of typography in various designs, from print to digital media, allowing designers to discover fonts used in actual projects and understand their applications.
problem_solved: Helps designers find and research fonts being used in real-world designs rather than just in type specimen generators.
why_valuable: Provides practical inspiration and context for typography choices, bridging the gap between font selection and actual design implementation.
